metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code plugins by Flopsstuff

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Generate and keep documentation in sync with your codebase

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Smart git workflow commands with intelligent conflict resolution

plugins.name: ksef
plugins.description: Send and receive KSeF (Polish National e-Invoice System) invoices via the ksef CLI, with guided onboarding: install from npm, token setup, login

plugins.name: resolve-coderabbit
plugins.description: Walk through CodeRabbit inline PR comments, verify each against the current code, and batch-resolve with commits and replies

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Run a codex code review against a base branch, then triage every finding with the user and land each accepted fix as its own verified commit

plugins.name: meshy
plugins.description: Generate 3D models, textures, rigs and animations from text or images via the Meshy AI API — a zero-dependency Node client wrapped in a skill

plugins.name: imagegen
plugins.description: Generate and edit images with Gemini image models (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) through a zero-dependency Node script, with guided API-key onboarding

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Build and drive n8n workflows — author them with the official n8n MCP server and its Workflow SDK, and operate the instance through its Public REST API

plugins.name: agents-init
plugins.description: Bootstrap a repository's agent instructions as one tool-agnostic AGENTS.md, with CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md symlinked to it

plugins.name: philips-air
plugins.description: Control Philips air purifiers and humidifiers (HU5710 and similar Air+ devices) on the local network over encrypted CoAP — LAN discovery, pairing, named devices, status, set with read-back verification

plugins.name: philips-airfryer
plugins.description: Control a Philips connected airfryer (5000 Series XL HD9280 / HD928x, FUSION firmware) through the Philips HomeID / Versuni cloud — email-code login, cook with presets, pause, resume, stop, adjust, keep warm, live status
